sprite_fix.cause: TMP MaterialReference and TMP_SubMeshUI may carry both the current font and a sprite asset. The previous font-only submesh check could replace the sprite material with the Cyrillic font material.
sprite_fix.change: Skip every spriteAsset submesh before applying any font-atlas repair. Preserve native sprite material, UVs, tint and masking instances.
sprite_fix.probe_scope: Hidden disabled Canvas; seven native sprite tags with Russian bold/italic text; exercise the old failure predicate; preserve compatible material clones and sprite-sheet texture; require coherent glyph atlases. Deferred if native story sprite sheet has not loaded.
